description: Plate sheen for lead snare. Programs the Plate FX wet-only at unity, feeds from Snare send slot 2. Complements snare-crack/gate-snare.
name: snare-plate
notes: Precondition: FX track Plate with plate-type reverb slot 0; Snare send slot 2 assigned to it (one-time setup in Cubase).
Multi-track preset: select Plate for calls 2-4, then select Snare for calls 5-7. Confirm with session.status before each group.
Prefer the plate algorithm on the plugin itself; process values are start points.
Response param field shows resolved titles; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Plugin mismatch names the actual insert plugin; adjust the plugin field and resend.
